t: What Direct Air Carbon Capture (DAC) Is
title: What Direct Air Carbon Capture (DAC) Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Direct air carbon capture machines pull CO2 straight from the atmosphere: giant fans blow air over sorbents that bind CO2, then heat or vacuum releases it as a pure stream for storage underground or use in products. It is the technology for undoing emissions. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Direct Air Carbon Capture (DAC): start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Direct Air Carbon Capture (DAC) in one line: Direct air carbon capture machines pull CO2 straight from the atmosphere: giant fans blow air over sorbents that bind CO2, then heat or vacuum releases it as a pure stream for storage underground or use in products.
Why it matters: Some emissions cannot be avoided; DAC plus storage can remove them — and eventually draw down the past..
Where it is used: carbon removal credits, synthetic fuels, building materials, enhanced oil recovery (transitional)..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
